summary: Frontend-only test of the new NotificationDialog flow in OrgDashboard. All 7 requested behaviours pass: dropdown 'Open' hint, click-to-open dialog with Admin-message label + title + formatted 'Received' date + full whitespace-preserved body (max-h-[50vh] scroll), Copy button copies '<title>\n\n<body>' with 'Message copied' toast, mark-as-read decrements badge count by 1 and removes unread styling (bg-primary/5 + blue dot), Escape/Close/X all close the dialog cleanly, dashboard stays interactive, and POST /api/admin/notifications regression correctly adds a new notif at the top of the dropdown with count incremented.
critical_code_review_comments: OrgDashboard.jsx is 666 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit. Consider extracting NotificationBell + NotificationDialog into /components/notifications/*.jsx for maintainability.
NotificationDialog re-clicks on an already-read notification still call the PATCH endpoint? — Verified via code: openMessage only calls onRead(n.id) when !n.read, so no redundant PATCH. Good.

Received-date parses n.created_at with `new Date(...)`. If backend ever returns a naive UTC string without 'Z', browser will treat it as local time and the 'Fri, 10 Jul 2026, 12:39' label may drift. Consider ensuring ISO-8601 with timezone on the backend.

The DialogContent uses max-w-lg. On very small mobile widths this is fine, but the body's `max-h-[50vh]` combined with the outer DialogContent padding can leave the Copy/Close row below the fold on short mobile screens — consider `max-h-[45vh]` or making the whole DialogContent scroll instead of the inner div.
The dropdown itself is `max-h-96 overflow-y-auto` — good. But there is no explicit 'mark all as read' affordance in the dropdown; the only way to clear the badge is to click through each unread item.
test_credentials: No auth needed. Role switched to 'org' via [data-testid=role-switcher] -> [data-testid=role-org]. Org slug: blackrod-town-council.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ notifications via POST /api/admin/notifications during the run: 'TEST_Notif_Dialog' (multi-line body) and 'TEST_Regression_Top_2026'. They remain in Mongo — main agent may want a cleanup step for TEST_ prefixed notifications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification dialog flow (bell -> dropdown -> click -> Radix Dialog with copy/close/escape + mark-as-read) is fully verified end-to-end against the live preview URL. Testids present: notification-bell, notification-count, notif-<id>, notification-dialog, notif-dialog-copy, notif-dialog-close. Clipboard permissions must be granted via page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) when re-testing the Copy button.
